items.title: Make DONE closeout snapshot durable across merge and cleanup
items.context: Ensure milestone-closeout.json is committed or copied into canonical story metadata during real DONE advancement, before the story worktree is removed.
items.userSees: After DONE, `lattice milestone_closeout --storyId=<story>` prints the final milestone table instead of Snapshot: missing.

happy.desc: A real story worktree DONE path leaves milestone-closeout.json present in canonical story metadata after worktree cleanup.

edge.desc: A DONE story without a milestone ledger still does not fabricate a closeout snapshot and reports a clear missing/not-applicable diagnostic.

adversarial.desc: A transient worktree-only milestone-closeout.json cannot be considered delivered unless the canonical root can read it after DONE cleanup.

verificationEvidence.note: Build passed and milestone-status regression passed. The new B-done-closeout-worktree fixture creates a real git worktree, advances DONE, removes the story worktree, then reads proofbound.milestone_closeout.v1 from canonical main.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "canonical main root can still|story worktree DONE path|merge cleanup" docs/CLI.md
verificationEvidence.note: docs/CLI.md lines 353-355 state that a story worktree DONE closeout is committed before removal and remains readable from canonical main after merge cleanup.

The worktree fixture asserts the story worktree no longer exists before canonical main Store and CLI milestone_closeout read the snapshot, so a transient worktree-only file cannot satisfy the test; existing missing-ledger cases also still pass.

items.title: Add post-DONE canonical-root regression coverage
items.context: Extend or add tests so removing the durable handoff from DONE effects makes the test fail; the test must assert canonical-root milestone_closeout succeeds after DONE cleanup, not only that the helper wrote a file in the worktree.
items.userSees: User sees test assertions for `milestone_closeout --storyId=B-done-closeout --root <mainRoot>` returning `proofbound.milestone_closeout.v1` after DONE cleanup.

happy.desc: The regression runs the full enough DONE path to prove canonical-root milestone_closeout reads a snapshot after cleanup.

edge.desc: The regression distinguishes canonical-root persistence from merely writing a worktree-local file.

adversarial.desc: The test fails if DONE cleanup deletes the only copy of milestone-closeout.json.

verificationEvidence.note: The regression runs a full enough DONE path through createStoryAdvanceHandlers from a linked story worktree and verifies canonical-root milestone_closeout returns proofbound.milestone_closeout.v1 after cleanup.
The regression distinguishes canonical-root persistence from worktree-local writes by instantiating a new StoryStore at mainRoot after worktree deletion and reading milestone-closeout.json there.
If DONE cleanup deletes the only closeout copy or fails to merge it into canonical metadata, the mainRoot Store/CLI assertions in the regression fail.
